seat-desk.README.md:
# Seat desk
Two source actions request a reservation. Production URL routing is unspecified.
seat-desk.ui/AAReserve.vue:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { placeBooking } from "./booking";
const props = defineProps<{ seat: string; account: string }>();
const reserve = () => placeBooking(props.seat, props.account);
</script>
<template><button @click="reserve">Reserve seat</button></template>
